## Checklist

- [ ] Built locally (`bash ./auto_build.sh --platform <your-platform>`) without new warnings
- [ ] Behavior change covered by the smoke matrix (`sd/io-test/run_smoke_matrix.sh`) or a manual run — describe below
- [ ] User-facing changes reflected in **both** `README.md` and `README_CN.md`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry added under the upcoming version (for feat / fix)
- [ ] No local working docs (PLAN-*.md, GOAL_*.md) or generated artifacts committed
